title: Acting on Climate Change is Key for Cambodia to Achieve its Development Goals
temporal_coverage: Historical hazard impacts and Cambodia CCDR projections summarized in the 2023 release.
methodology: World Bank release summarizing selected Cambodia CCDR findings and historical event estimates.
limitations: Headline figures are reported without full event-attribution or model-method detail on this page.

title: Cambodia’s NDC 3.0
organization: Government of Cambodia, Ministry of Environment
temporal_coverage: National vulnerability evidence and adaptation measures in the 2025 NDC 3.0, including targets through 2035.
methodology: Government submission synthesizing cited climate-risk, poverty, sector, and policy sources.
limitations: Some hazard estimates are attributed to cited secondary studies; planned measures and targets are not completed outcomes.

title: Climate Change and Migration Patterns: Findings at the Commune Level in Rural Provinces of Cambodia
geographic_coverage: Kbal Romeas Commune, Stung Treng Province
temporal_coverage: Household survey and local interviews in July 2023; recalled hazard and migration patterns over the preceding decade.
methodology: Mixed-method study using surveys of 240 households with migrants, 15 key-informant interviews and local stakeholder consultations across three communes.
limitations: Cross-sectional migrant-household sample; reported pathways are locally grounded, not causal estimates or nationally representative.

title: Climate rationale for water, sanitation and hygiene services in Cambodia
organization: UNICEF Cambodia and Stockholm International Water Institute
geographic_coverage: rural and urban WASH service areas
temporal_coverage: August 2024 publication; climate-risk mapping includes historical observations, 2019 census service data and projections.
methodology: Climate-risk analysis combines available datasets, GIS mapping and multi-stakeholder consultation across WASH subsectors.
limitations: National-sector risk screening uses uneven underlying data; proposed actions are not evaluated outcomes.

title: Disorientations: The Political Ecology of ‘Displacing’ Floating Communities from Cambodia's Tonle Sap Lake
temporal_coverage: Fieldwork in displaced and non-displaced communities from 2018 through 2023; analysis of relocation and hydrological change.
methodology: Ethnographic study using interviews, community workshops and participatory mapping with displaced and non-displaced Tonle Sap communities.
limitations: Qualitative case study; it does not quantify population-wide effects or isolate climate from dams and other development drivers.

title: The role of perceived peer effect in shaping farmers’ adaptive behaviors in Cambodia
geographic_coverage: Eight villages in the Tonle Sap Lake area near Achang irrigation dam
temporal_coverage: Household and network data collected in 2023; publication June 2026.
methodology: Mixed-method household survey, interviews and field observations analyzed with social-influence models.
limitations: Eight-village sample; network measures are self-reported and authors could not identify causal diffusion dynamics.
